name: atlas-figure-swarm
description: Domain-specific multi-agent /swarm plugin for scientific paper figures, system overview diagrams, architecture pipelines, and publication-ready graphical abstracts on Google Antigravity 2.0, with coexistence-safe rules, scoped file-ownership hooks, and delivery contract gates.
suggestedPrompts: /swarm 启动 atlas-figure-swarm 团队，帮我完成：【描述你的领域目标】。先由规划员锁定大纲与目录权限表，再并行产出并交叉核验交付物。
/swarm 启动 atlas-figure-swarm 分片调研组，并行处理以下多个子主题并汇总对比结论：【列出主题 A / B / C】。
/swarm 启动 atlas-figure-swarm 独立验收组，按交付契约对当前产出目录执行质量、事实与结构终审。
